hero.subtitle: A Computer Science student and Software Engineer. I bridge the gap between robust C#/.NET backends, dynamic React interfaces, and modern Cloud-Native architectures to build scalable, end-to-end applications.

about.title: Beyond the Code.
about.p1: I am a Computer Science student at Cracow University of Technology with a highly pragmatic approach to problem-solving. I view software engineering not just as writing syntax, but as designing reliable systems that deliver tangible value. I take ownership of my work, thriving on the challenge of transforming complex business requirements into logical, well-structured architectures.
about.p2: My professional journey didn't start in an IDE. Years of experience in customer service forged one of my strongest assets: communication. I learned how to listen actively, de-escalate stressful situations, and translate complex technical jargon into clear, user-friendly language. I build for people, not just for machines.
about.p3: My drive to learn and optimize extends beyond traditional programming. I actively leverage AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline my daily workflows and accelerate development. When I step away from the keyboard to maintain a healthy balance, you'll find me out on running trails, hitting the gym, exploring new tech trends, or practicing my Spanish.

skills.title: Tools of the Trade.
skills.p1: From database design to automated cloud provisioning, I utilize a modern and versatile toolset. I focus on strict backend principles like Clean Architecture and MediatR, combined with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and serverless deployments (Azure) to ensure highly reliable, scalable performance.
skills.p2: On the frontend, I apply a detail-oriented engineering approach. Leveraging React and TypeScript, I build modular, performant interfaces rooted in the DRY principle. By eliminating redundant CSS, extracting complex logic into reusable components, and seamlessly integrating i18n localization.
skills.p3: Additionally, I actively bridge the engineering side with intelligent tools. By embracing advanced AI Workflows and Prompt Engineering, I accelerate my learning curves, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and streamline daily testing routines.
